name: The Risk Takers
summary: Featuring commentary by comedian Jang Dong-min, this fierce game has all players strategizing to get the most "seeds" and rise as the Death Game Master.

name: Stray Kids: All-Night SKZ
summary: A pajama party themed reality show starring Stray Kids members Bang Chan, Changbin, Felix and Seungmin.

name: The Ambiguous Focus
summary: Adapted from the online novel Mr. and Mr. Zhang, the film tells the story of how Zhang Nan and Zhang Zhe, a homosexual couple, recover from betrayal and breakup. Zhe struggles in a life alone after Nan's leaving. With the help from his friends Chunzi and Chao, Zhe learns to be independent. Even when the truth comes out, both Nan and Zhe are too hurt to patch things up. Nonetheless, they have to choose between getting back together or letting the other one go.

name: Star City Police
summary: Two guys fall in love with each other. BaiYan is a ganster. QingYun is a detective. This is their story.

name: Haute saison
summary: Haute Saison is a French comedy-crime television series set in the seaside town of Biarritz. The series follows a diverse team of police reinforcements managing increased crime during the busy summer months.

name: The Last Duel
summary: The story of Prince Nares, the son of King Maha Thammaracha and Queen Wisut Kasattri who was sent as a political hostage to the city of Hongsawadi as a royal youth. There, he grew up alongside Mingyi Swa, the beloved grandson of King Bayinnaung. Nares and Mingyi Swa had polar-opposite personalities—whereas Nares was bold, fond of combat, and feared no one, Mingyi Swa was calm, gentle, and had a love of art and nature—both their differences forged a bond between them stronger than that of true brothers. However, as each aged into their own responsibilities and duties to reclaim their homelands, the once fraternal friendship transformed into a bitter battle of adversaries.

name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo: Kuromajutsu Satsujin Jiken-hen
summary: "Black Magic Murder Case" is a two-part OVA released on DVD to celebrate 20th anniversary of Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo series.

previousepisode.name: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo: Black Magic Murder Case (Part Two)

name: Mas Fhior
summary: Niall Iain Macdonald hosts a quiz show where more than general knowledge is required to win. Standing in the way of our two teams from winning are the Pretenders who, from the comfort of their own homes, are on a mission to fox our contestants.

name: Éttermek csatája
summary: In the Battle of the Restaurants, two restaurants, two teams and real guests can decide the fate of the chefs. Two separate restaurants are fighting for the favor of the guests. Paletta, the restaurant of Ákos Sárközi, and Espelette, the restaurant of Jenő Rácz. The two Michelin-starred chefs have recruited a team of 8 people each, where semi-professional and professional chefs will work under their hands.

name: Greim-Bìdh le Gregor
summary: Gregor MacLeod brings us the tastiest recipes using local produce on the Isle of Lewis.

name: Adresse Wien
summary: Europe is once again gathering for a folk festival. 37 countries are ready for the world's biggest music show, this year from Vienna.

name: RoboCop
summary: In RoboCop, a giant tech conglomerate convinces the city to place a powerful robot on its police force – a robot implanted with the consciousness of a beloved, fallen officer, Alex Murphy

name: Meat the Carvers
summary: A horrifying animated comedy about a monstrously diverse New Jersey family who eat bad people.

name: I'm A Celebrity... Unpacked (South Africa)
summary: It's back, baby! Sam Thomson and Kemi Rodgers unpack all the juiciest jungle gossip, delving deeper into camp life with unseen clips and exclusive interviews.

name: How to Clean Up for Cash
summary: Josie Gibson presents as families have a loved one's clutter cleared and valued in secret by antiques expert Dan Hatfield and declutterer Jacqueline McLeod.

name: Берлин'23
summary:
Vyacheslav Vasiliev, an experienced crisis manager who successfully completed a mission in Warsaw two years earlier, arrives in Berlin to replace the exiled Russian diplomats. His main task is not only to ensure the work of the deserted embassy, but also to prevent the growing global conflict in Europe. As in Poland, in Germany he will work in tandem with a special services operative Sergei Nenashev. Vasilyev has the diplomatic part of the task, Nenashev will act in the usual role of an illegal. Their past conflicts are over ― they worked well together, besides, Vasiliev is grateful to his partner for saving his daughter.

 According to the Russian side, German Defense Minister Becker, unbeknownst to his own government, is preparing a secret arsenal and mercenaries to participate in the war against Russia. Risking their lives and reputations, Nenashev and Vasiliev will try to uncover the conspiracy of Western intelligence services and prevent the opening of an alternative total front against Russia.

name: Trust Me: The False Prophet
summary: This documentary series investigates the disturbing rise of an egomaniacal polygamist and self-proclaimed heir to notorious FLDS leader Warren Jeffs.

previousepisode.name: I See That Girl in Third Person

name: Revenge of the False Bride
summary: Burdened by a tragic past, the orphaned Lily assumes the identity of Evelyn, the long-lost heiress of the wealthy Sinclair family, to exact her revenge. As part of her plan, she enters into an arranged marriage with the cold and ruthless Commander Julian Blackwood.What begins as a calculated alliance unexpectedly becomes her safest sanctuary. As Lily maneuvers through the treacherous schemes of her stepmother, the cutthroat business guilds, and the family's pharmaceutical empire, Julian remains her silent protector—her sword and her shield.However, the sudden arrival of a former brother-in-arms brings to light a dark secret from the war, casting a shadow of suspicion over Julian. Amidst the entanglement of love and hate, aristocratic conspiracies and the threat of foreign invasion close in. In the end, amidst the smoke of battle, she sheds her disguise and reclaims her true name, standing side by side with the man who loves her for who she really is, to fight for the future of their nation.

name: Chopped Castaways
summary: Chopped Castaways strands 12 elite chefs on a remote island, where survival skills are just as critical as culinary talent. Battling the elements across two grueling cooking rounds each week, competitors must build a working kitchen from basic supplies, earn their signature Chopped ingredient baskets through intense physical challenges, and cook entirely over open fire. Culinary heavyweights Gabe Bertaccini, Maneet Chauhan and Marcus Samuelsson serve as judges throughout the arced competition, offering guidance while deciding who advances—and who is chopped. The season begins as a team competition before dissolving into an individual battle, raising the stakes as the chefs fight to outlast their rivals and claim the $100,000 grand prize. Only the most resilient, strategic, and adaptive chef will survive island life and the pressure of the competition.

name: Тұз
summary: Aisulu is a student from a poor family. She dreams of paying her tuition and helping her family. At a freshman reception, she meets Ratmir and gradually becomes close to him. Under the influence of genuine feelings, she is drawn into Ratmir's world: she becomes addicted to drugs and begins to do illegal things for Ratmir. As a result, she begins to have problems with her studies, work, and family. She even ends up in the police. Over time, she realizes that she is not the only one who sacrificed her freedom and life for Ratmir, that Ratmir has been using the girls in his neighborhood to distribute drugs.

name: Кумиры Кумиров
summary: Many music lovers have their own idols, whose music they are willing to listen to endlessly. This is not surprising, but few people think about whose talents the stars themselves worship. Popular TV presenter Alexander Pushnoy decides to find out and invites the most iconic figures of the music world and artists of other genres to his own studio.

name: The Day
summary:
The Day is a propulsive edge-of-your-seat thriller unfolding across a single, gripping day. When police stumble across a bank robbery mid-heist, the criminals barricade themselves inside, and a terrifying siege begins.

The series opens from the police perspective, led by hostage negotiator Sylvia "Vox" Voxley, as she battles time and rising pressure to save the hostages. But as the crisis hurtles towards breaking point, the story rewinds - pulling viewers inside the bank to relive the same events through the eyes of the robbers and their hostages. 

With each episode flipping perspective between the police operation and the robbers barricaded inside, The Day constantly resets the narrative. Every shift in perspective reframes the truth and deepens the mystery - building to an explosive finale where the full picture finally snaps into place.

name: Juntas & Separadas
summary: Separation is never easy. After 40, it's even harder. The four friends must relearn how to flirt, face the struggles of going out with nowhere to sit, and understand all the new rules of modern relationships. Now imagine all that combined with less collagen, hair loss, and menopause. They meet at Bar do Leme to share their problems and victories, while Lacerda, the traditional and experienced bartender, serves drinks and sharp advice. Sometimes they love endless nights at bars, enjoying the freedom of not having to answer to anyone. Other times, they feel lonely. But they always have each other (in good times and bad) to support and embrace one another. That's sisterhood. One lifts the other up. This series explores, with humor and lightness, the pleasures and pains of returning to single life. A stage where we are still young enough to enjoy life and mature enough to avoid bad choices. Or maybe not. After all… is it possible to rediscover yourself and reinvent your life after forty?

name: Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her
summary: Seven years after making a childhood promise to always be friends, Hayato is reunited with his formerly tomboyish pal Haruki at a city high school–only now, Haruki has transformed into the girl every guy dreams about! While Haruki's looks may have changed, with Hayato, she's still the same pal he remembers. Despite years apart, their promise and feelings remain and deepen into something stronger.

name: George Clarke's Two Houses, One Home
summary:
George Clarke's Two Houses, One Home will feature two separate households who dream of living together under one roof. Whether it's a couple moving in together for the first time, two halves of a soon to be blended family, or grandparents ready to be closer to their loved ones, they will all have something in common; two houses that don't work for the next stage of their lives and the need for one dream home fit for them all.

Each episode will follow one group on their property journey as they try to create the home that brings their two households together. They will sell the house they no longer need, channelling the money into renovating the remaining house, into their dream home.

name: The Boss's Delusion
summary: An overworked employee vents by writing a steamy romance starring her icy boss. Disaster strikes when she accidentally emails it to him instead of her resignation! Rather than firing her, the arrogant CEO assumes she's wildly in love with him—and starts reciprocating her "feelings." Forced to lead his new AI romance project to save her job, the lines between fiction and reality blur. How long can she keep up the charade before she actually falls for him?

name: Train‑ing It with Joe Wilkinson
summary: What do you get when you combine Joe Wilkinson, his love of trains and famous faces that he admires? A sort of train based podcast thing… that's kind of it, really. With Joe's love of train travel and all things "behind the scenes", he's gatecrashing the real train journeys of people he admires and going along for (their) ride.

name: Next on the Menu
summary: Next on the Menu gives unprecedented access to the development kitchens and teams at some of the country's biggest food retailers for a competition format that pulls back the curtain on the real processes behind how new menu items are conceived, tested and launched. Each episode introduces a brand‑new cast of dedicated superfans who step inside the beating heart of these major chains and bring their ideas to the table to turn their culinary dreams into commercially viable reality.

name: Wrong Move
summary:
When it comes to stress, buying a property is right up there with bereavement and divorce. And the worst part of the whole thing is dealing with the people you're buying from and selling to. 

40-somethings Michael and Catherine are making a marriage-saving move into their dream ‘forever home', selling to parents-to-be Stella and Juliette, who are selling to first-time buyers Asif and Emily. This trio of households find themselves at the mercy of the psychopath at the top of the chain, Detective Sergeant Trevor Bamford. 

Obsessed with getting his money's worth, Trevor calls the move off the night before the sale, causing hell for everyone else. As the buyers come together to sort the problem, a confrontation has deadly consequences.

name: Close to Home
summary: Close to Home tells the story of Sean, a young man who finds himself back in Belfast. Back from university and back into old habits. Back on the mad all-nighters, the borrowed tenners and missing rent, the casual jobs that always fall through. Back with his brother, his ma and all the things they never talk about. Back where the promised prosperity of peacetime has yet to arrive and every street has a story to tell. One night, Sean assaults a stranger at a party and everything is tipped into chaos.

name: Links To Temptation
summary: Kwan Ho-Chin is the daughter of rich businessman Ko Wing-Tai, Ko not only abandoned the unborn Kwan and her mother in Macao but stole her mother's life savings to begin his business empire. Years later in Hong Kong Kwan plots revenge, and hires Macao pole dancer Hung Long-Kiu to seduce Ko with the aim of pretending that Hung is Ko's daughter once they have become lovers.

previousepisode.name: Xiaohui refused to disclose the truth

name: Les Hordes
summary: In the near future, the poor and the underprivileged will come together to form roving road gangs. They form hordes that increasingly worry the state. In order to thwart the small group, a police officer declared dead infiltrates the hordes ...

name: Good Bones
summary: Good Bones is described as an erotic thriller set in the world of country music. Plot details are being kept under wraps but the show is said to be set in Nashville and, as the title suggests, there is house flipping/renovation involved.

name: The One That Got Away With Murder
summary: When a guarded new girl with a dark past transfers to a high school across the country, she's drawn to the former golden boy who is now a notorious outcast suspected of killing his girlfriend. Determined to know the truth, she secretly investigates, uncovering a web of secrets and lies, as she closes in on the killer who got away with murder.

name: The Sun Beyond Two Lifetimes
summary: A chance encounter at a Buddhist temple sparks an unforgettable love that transcends time. In their first life, Yun Xi and Xuan Heng fall in love after being brought together by a small bird. But when Yun Xi is forced into the imperial palace as a concubine, Xuan Heng risks everything to rescue her, only to be falsely accused and executed. Devastated, Yun Xi follows him into death. As their jade pendants unite amid the flames, destiny grants them another chance. Reborn in the modern world, comic artist Qin Xi unexpectedly reunites with Chu Heng, a powerful CEO and her childhood betrothed. Drawn together by an invisible bond, the two fall in love once more. When their matching jade pendants awaken memories of their tragic past, they must confront the unfinished fate that has followed them across two lifetimes and fight to rewrite the ending they were once denied.

name: Cunk on Cinema
summary: Philomena will be asking experts all of the hard-hitting questions about the history of cinema, from the invention of the camera, to the New Wave filmmakers of the 60s, right up to entrance of CGI and what the future of AI holds. Cunk will attempt to demystify it all while sitting in lumpy seats with stale popcorn, asking herself where did cinema come from? And why? What does it want? And why can't it tell us?

name: Lying
summary: A woman is seeking revenge for past betrayal. Her heart, hardened by the pain of the past, drives her to take extreme measures to get back at those who wronged her. In the process, she is willing to destroy even the love of those around her.

name: My Killer Father: The Green Hollow Murders
summary: My Killer Father: The Green Hollow Murders unravels a decades-long mystery of The Monster of Green Hollow, a rumored serial killer believed to have murdered dozens of women including three of his wives, deaths once ruled as suicides. When one of his now adult-aged children breaks her silence and comes forward saying she was forced to help bury bodies on their property, their family begins to fracture as a three-year investigation by filmmakers unearths the secrets buried within a family - and in the hills of Green Hollow.

name: Cooking Italy
summary: Canadian chefs Rob Rossi and Craig Harding featured in a series traveling through Italy, including Sardinia, Liguria, and Veneto, to learn traditional methods.

name: Doctor X
summary: Genius surgeon Gye Su-jeong joins Guseo University Hospital and quickly proves her brilliance while challenging flaws in the medical system, all while navigating complex relationships with the hospital's director and an intern.

name: Race Across the World: The Detour
summary:
Broadcaster, DJ and Celebrity Race Across the World contestant Tyler West hosts the new video podcast Race Across the World: The Detour. The podcast will also feature series four winner Alfie Watts, sharing his top travel tips and hacks.

Each week the podcast will welcome guests from travel-savvy creators, to comedians and celebrity fans of the show, as they dissect destinations, swap tales of adventure, and celebrate the real life stories and unforgettable journeys of Race Across the World.

previousepisode.name: The Final Leg with Comedian Harriet Kemsley and Emon and Jamiul from Series 2

name: Legends
summary: Surrounded by drug lords, a team of regular civil servants faces a nerve-racking undercover mission to take them down.

name: Calamities
summary: Calamities is a gripping and propulsive Texas crime thriller like no other. After a drug deal explodes into violence, a quiet border town is thrust into a deadly collision course between a small-town sheriff looking for answers from her past, a sociopathic hit woman, an overly eager FBI agent, and a ruthless sect of the cartel.

name: Riding the Wind
summary: In an era of booming national development, Xiao Yifan starts as a greenhorn in the corporate world. Through relentless effort and a sharp market instinct, he defeats his rivals and rises fast to become a top player in the real estate industry. But he doesn't stop there. He leads his team in a bold transformation, rebranding the company and reshaping its future.

name: No Way! My Bro Is the Emperor
summary: Senior slacker Gu Bei is transported back in time and becomes a frontier general. After spending three carefree years living off the success of Xiaoyao Pavilion, an imperial decree summons him back to the capital, where he discovers that Emperor Xiao Ce is actually his former roommate. One dreams of taking it easy and becoming the richest man alive, while the other is determined to become one of history's greatest emperors. Together, the two brothers use modern thinking to outsmart corrupt officials, take down powerful drug lords, fend off western invaders, and hilariously rewrite their destinies in the ancient world.

name: Grayson Perry Has Seen the Future
summary: Artist Sir Grayson Perry visits Silicon Valley to explore how AI and robotics will shape the future in a series that raises profound questions about what it is to be human.

name: The Reborn Young Lord
summary: His soul transmigrates into the body of Ning Chen, the illegitimate son of the Ning family in the Great Xuan Kingdom. After enduring endless humiliation, he rises up and strikes back. He stuns the capital with his poetry, joins the Inspection Bureau and cracks one mysterious case after another, revolutionizes the battlefield with innovative firearms, captures enemy commanders alive at the frontier, and ultimately uncovers the truth behind his mother's murder. Step by step, he turns the tables on his tormentors, sharpens his edge amidst the schemes of power, and forges a legendary name that echoes across the Great Xuan, a young hero for the ages.

name: Под ударом
summary: Olga gets a job as a nanny for the charismatic businessman Artamonov, a man with an impeccable reputation and a model family man. He bears the trials he's faced with dignity: his wife, Galina, suffers from a severe mental disorder and has already attempted to kill him. One day, while walking with Anya, Olga sees a woman in town who resembles Galina. This strikes her as odd, as Artamonov's wife never leaves the house. The next day, Galina falls down the stairs and is hospitalized unconscious. Anya finds a letter from her mother, warning her of dire danger and begging her to flee the house.

name: Within The Grip
summary: Crown Prince Yin Zhou, seeking refuge from an investigation, disguises himself as Gu Zhaoxi and infiltrates the Gu household. Meanwhile, Gu Yuluo seizes the opportunity to use Yin Zhou in her own quest to uncover the hidden truth of her origins. Each carrying their own secrets, the two evolve from fierce adversaries into a partnership built on quiet, growing trust! Caught in the crosscurrents of human desire and political ambition, what choices do they make when faced with a web of lies, shattering truths, and life-or-death stakes?

name: Hao Yi Ge Guai Guai Nv
Turning Life Around
summary: Trapped youth Zhang Xiaobei holds the key to fate and swaps lives with top-tier heir Sheng Yuanzhou! Rising from desperation to fortune, he protects his family and hunts down the killer of his sister. In this mutual redemption between two boys, a 30-day countdown forces a brutal test of humanity. Together, they expose a grand conspiracy and exact hardcore revenge on the mastermind behind it all!

name: The Age of Fire
summary: A foot massage therapist and son of an ex-con, Zhu Chaoyang, travels from 2025 back into the body of his father, Zhu Yihai, in 1997. Armed with a modern mindset, the reborn Zhu Yihai conquers one obstacle after another, leading his buddies to wealth and crushing the schemes of local bully Long Xiao. In doing so, he rewrites his fate!

name: Jury Duty Presents: Behind the Scenes of Company Retreat
summary: Company Retreat is a documentary-style comedy series that follows the annual week-long getaway for Rockin' Grandma's Hot Sauce through the eyes of their new temp worker, Anthony. With a behind the scenes look at the making of the season. Including audio commentary, a meeting of Anthony Norman and Ronald Gladden and a Reunion with the main cast from the season.

name: Encantadia
summary:
In the world of Encantadia, four Sang'gres guard the gems that hold the power to maintain peace and harmony in the land.

Pirena, the eldest of the four Sang'gres, is the keeper of the Gem of Fire. Passionate and outspoken, the fiery young woman wishes to become the next queen of the diwatas (fairies).
Amihan, the second eldest, is the keeper of the Gem of Air. Mature and nurturing, her nature is to protect her loved ones no matter the cost.
Alena, the third sister, is the keeper of the Gem of Water. Romantic and carefree, she lives to love and is in a quest to find the person who will complete her.
And Danaya, the youngest, is the keeper of the Gem of Earth. Fearless and headstrong, she has an unwavering sense of justice, which is tested as she learns that the world is never black and white.

The sisters' strong bond is broken when Pirena discovers that she is unlike them. Their mother, Ynang Reyna Minea, is afraid of her desire to become the ruler of Encantadia and it is this imagined betrayal that leads her to become susceptible to the manipulations of Hagorn, King of Hathoria. This sets into motion an epic journey for the Sang'gres to discover the importance of family, love, and forgiveness.

name: Encantadia
summary: In the magical land of Encantadia, the Sang'gre sisters Alena, Danaya, Amihan, and Pirena are assigned to protect the four kingdoms within Encantadia. They are entrusted with four diamonds that will maintain peace throughout the land. But the ambition of Pirena, the eldest Sang'gre, will destroy this peace. One against three, sister against sister. Who will win this fight?

name: Secret Africa: Into the Wild
summary:
Secret Africa: Into the Wild follows British explorer Lucy Shepherd as she self-films whilst she undertakes a high-risk, on-foot expedition across remote regions of Tanzania alongside an Indigenous Hadza and Akie team.

Moving through thorn forest and open savannah, the expedition takes place in territory shared with some of Africa's most dangerous wildlife. Hyenas stalk camps at night, elephants come out of no where, and prides of lions hunt across the same land the team must cross on foot. With no vehicles and limited supplies, every decision carries consequence.

The team face real physical and environmental pressure, the series reveals a rarely seen Africa and exposes the true realities of modern exploration.

name: Etheria: Ang Ikalimang Kaharian ng Encantadia
summary: After serenity was restored in Encantadia, the past sneaks up on the strong-willed sisters. With the lives of their loved ones at stake, they must go back in time to stop a vengeful tribe in their plan to annihilate the present. In their journey, many questions would be answered. And despite all the insurmountable obstacles, the sisters must destroy the past to save the present.

name: Encantadia: Pag-ibig Hanggang Wakas
summary: The four Sang'gres of Encantadia - Amihan, Pirena, Alena, and Danaya - return from the past after they successfully destroyed the kingdom of Etheria. In the midst of their celebration in Sapiro, Mine-a suddenly arrives and warns the Sang'gres about an impending danger that only they can solve.

name: Великая и забытая
summary: It was not customary to recall the First World War in the Soviet Union. The situation hasn't changed much these days either. What our knowledge of the First World War consists of today is largely based on how this war was presented in Soviet history textbooks.

name: Inevitable Justice
summary: Desperate to fund his critically ill daughter's treatment, Luo Xiao is coerced by gang leader Chen Yongjiang into a gruesome dismemberment case. To save himself, Luo Xiao kills Chen Yongjiang in self-defense, and then seizes his position and takes over an underground money-laundering operation. As police officer Zhang Heng digs deeper into the investigation, he uncovers traces of Luo Xiao's crimes and the tangled web of illicit capital behind them. The harder the police push, the more a vast criminal network, spanning murder, money laundering, and medical corruption, rises to the surface through a series of breathtaking confrontations and fateful choices.

name: Капитан Кракен и его команда
summary: This is a story about three little kids who dream of becoming real pirates. The small fish Flip, the small jellyfish Sue and the sea duck Quack live with their grandfather - rather strange old retired pirate Captain Kraken. Together they learn the wisdom of pirate life that results in many comic and funny adventures.

name: Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre
summary: Terra grew up timid, feeling different due to her ability to talk to animals. Haunted by the mystery of her past—her father died when she was a baby, and her mother abandoned her soon after—she struggles with insecurity. On her 18th birthday, Terra discovers she has superpowers and learns she is the last princess of Encantadia, a hidden realm of enchanted beings. When an evil queen conquers Encantadia and threatens the mortal world, Terra must rise to protect both realms and embrace her true destiny.

name: Superrace Freestyle
summary: A showdown between 10 of Korea's top racing teams. With an operating budget of 100 million won, each team must purchase a vehicle and transform it into a freestyle racing car through custom tuning.

name: TechTown
summary: At TechTown, Alan, Adam, Ellie, Britt and their manager Rowan rarely get any real work done, often finding themselves bored to death.

name: LIS
summary: Petra and the other young LIS doctors have just started their rotation at the hospital. A dramatic six months will bind them closely together.

name: Asawa Ko, Karibal Ko
summary: Rachel meets Nathan, a gay man who later marries her when pressured by family. Unhappy and trapped, Nathan plans to fake his death, and later he undergoes a sexual reassignment and facial surgery in another country. Years later, Rachel meets and falls for Gavin, who has a wife named Venus--who is actually what her former husband Nathan has made of himself.

name: Pusong ligaw
summary: A tale about friendship, love, and dreams, featuring two women, Tessa and Marga, from poor families. Caloy, a friend, falls in love with Tessa's mentor, wealthy Jaime Laurel, while Marga uses Caloy's jealousy to undermine Tessa's faith.

name: History's Greatest Machines with Dolph Lundgren
summary: Machines can rewrite history – and no one knows that better than action legend and chemical engineer graduate Dolph Lundgren. Join him as he uncovers the stories behind history's most groundbreaking machines: witness secret stealth helicopters, spy planes outrunning missiles, espionage tech that won wars, to the rocket that took humanity to the moon. Guided by Dolph's keen insight and charisma, this is a thrilling ride through the gears, guts, and genius behind the machines that reshaped our world.

name: Wooju Bakery
summary: An alien prince crashes into a baker's grand opening, forcing the two into an unlikely partnership to rebuild the shop and find a home.

name: Les Justiciers
summary: Three experienced lawyers hear disputes between citizens and deliberate among themselves to determine the amount of damages to be awarded.

name: Salish & Jordan Matter
summary: One wildly creative dad who loves a challenge. One up-for-anything daughter who loves to win. Together, they put "family time" to the ultimate test.

previousepisode.name: FLYING ALONE for the First Time

name: Luka, Makan, Cinta
summary: To save her mother's restaurant, ambitious chef Luka has no choice but to work alongside talented newcomer Dennis. The only catch? She hates him.

name: Alguien Tiene Que Saber
summary: When a teen goes missing, a detective and his team launch a tireless investigation to solve the mystery in this drama series inspired by true events.

name: Ronaldinho Gaúcho
summary: With a laid-back style and masterful dribbling skills, Ronaldinho became a star on and off the soccer field. This is his story — as never seen before.

name: The Hidden Love
summary: On a snowy night in the Northern City, Zhong Xiran is abandoned by her first love, Huo Xin, and finds herself married to Qi Sinian, a man who has secretly loved her for eleven years. Four years of a cold, loveless marriage follow, plagued by her ex's return, family pressure, and scandal after scandal. Then she makes a shocking discovery. Their marriage was a long-planned act of devotion. When the truth finally comes to light, she turns and falls into his arms. "The rest of my life is yours."

name: Mga Batang Riles
summary: A group of young men gets wrongfully accused of a crime, sending them to a public juvenile center. Their goal is to clean their names and find the real perpetrator as they fend for themselves.

name: Dreams : 1 rêve, 2 vies
summary: The series follows Julia Delacourt, a young woman who dreams of becoming a singer despite her father's wishes for her to follow in his footsteps at his hotel group. To pursue her passion without her father knowing, Julia adopts a secret double life.

name: This Palace Maid Isn't Very Calm
summary: Shen Zhaodi, a modern doctor of traditional Chinese medicine, is suddenly transported into a palace intrigue novel and reborn as a cannon-fodder maid who meets a brutal death right at the beginning. With her superb medical skills and knowledge of the future plot, she turns her misfortune around completely. She cures the Empress Dowager, helps the original female lead rise to power, and also develops a bittersweet, time-defying romance with the icy Fourteenth Prince. Follow her journey as she stays calm amid the dangerous imperial palace, stages a magnificent reversal, and lives a life truly her own!

name: Just to Meet You
summary: A three-time widow enters a marriage of convenience with Ye Lang, the secret son of the richest tycoon, thinking she's scored a harmless, lovestruck "puppy" of a husband. But she couldn't be more wrong. She walks straight into the trap of a powerful man reborn with memories of his past life. In his past life, Ye Lang died on their wedding day, his love unreturned and his heart shattered. Given a second chance, he vows revenge, yet once again finds himself falling for her gentle charm. As passion and vengeance collide, hidden truths begin to unravel. And just when they think they understand the game, a darker secret emerges... They're not the only ones who came back.

name: Spring Over Phoenix Pond
summary: Qi Yuan, the butcher's daughter, was the true heiress of the Marquis Residence who was switched at birth. The fake heiress framed and humiliated Qi Yuan to protect herself. Forced into becoming Prince Jing Xiao Yunting's hidden guard, Qi Yuan and Xiao Yunting gradually fell in love. On their wedding night, Prince Qi broke in recklessly. Qi Yuan died together with him, only to discover she had been reborn. In this life, she will let no one stand in her way...

name: The Double Game
summary: Wen Yan goes undercover as a wealthy family's daughter-in-law to gather evidence, while Lu Tingxiao schemes for power to avenge his mother. As it happens, she's the impostor who once spent a night with him. By day, she beats up her useless husband while he secretly plots murders; by night, they each harbor hidden agendas. From mutual suspicion to joining forces to bring down the family, their forbidden love spirals out of control amid the high-stakes game.

name: RaiRaiRaise Demo Chanto Shimasu
summary: Spin-off to Raise de wa Chanto Shimasu (season 2).

name: The Floor
summary:
The Floor is an exciting quiz show where one hundred contestants compete to dominate a giant digital board divided into one hundred squares, each representing a different area of knowledge.

The game is simple: challenge your opponents, win their squares, and conquer the entire board. In successive fast-paced and intense duels, contestants must identify images, sounds, or answer questions faster than their rivals. Each contestant will showcase their personality episode after episode. Diversity, excitement, and strategy combine in this race for total domination.

Who will conquer The Floor?

name: Dickie
summary: Dickie is the universal loser. Whether he is a farmer or a pirate, a knight or an astronaut, things always end badly for him. In a series of two-minute animated shorts, we follow the amusing exploits of this pitiful yet sympathetic antihero, who shares our own shortcomings and weaknesses. Based on a popular comic strip, Dickie holds up a mirror to our society.

name: I Bid You Peace: The Rise & Fall of the Frugal Gourmet
summary: TV chef Jeff Smith was beloved in the 80s-90s until multiple former teenage employees accused him of sexual abuse; exploring these allegations through interviews with survivors, colleagues and journalists.

name: Adepta Sororitas: Penitence
summary: A group of Adepta Sororitas must overcome a physical and spiritual ordeal as they seek to deliver a sacred relic to its ordained resting place.

name: Housoukyoku Senkyo Go: Sequel
summary: Ibuki Yuji becomes entangled in a new hostage crisis, where a deadly psychological battle unfolds. Moreover, Suruga Saki—one of the "Beasts", returns once again! What is the true meaning behind Suruga's reappearance?

name: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries
summary: Cheryl Cooper escapes to an Amish community in Sugarcreek, Ohio, to manage a gift shop after a failed engagement. Drawn into one mystery after another, Cheryl quickly realizes her sharp instincts and outsider perspective are exactly what this tight-knit community needs.

name: Mavis Eccleston
summary: The tragic and extraordinary real-life story of a woman who survived a joint suicide pact with the love of her life and husband of nearly 60 years and was subsequently arrested and charged with his murder.

name: Thérèse Humbert
summary: A 19th-century French peasant woman orchestrates the "swindle of the century" by inventing a fictitious American millionaire heir, using the promise of a massive imaginary inheritance to swindle bankers and elites, living in lavish luxury until her spectacular exposure in 1902.

previousepisode.name: Si l'argent ne fait pas le bonheur, rendez-le !

name: One Day In My Body
summary: This bold and intimate series hands the camera to those living with some of the world's rarest medical conditions. Meet an individual allergic to water, a woman who ages at an unusually rapid rate, a woman who has been unable to empty her bladder in years, and other complex disorders that leave the most skilled medical professionals searching for answers.

name: My Dream Is Fencing
summary: International fencer Sun doesn't quite live in the present; he's preoccupied with past and present, making him unfocused. As a kid, Sun trained in the Athamat Thai swordsmanship style of his grandfather. Later, when Sun took up the international sabre, his style as a fencer was outstanding, though he was held back by his lack of focus. Sun lives with his mother, Rungthiwa—who has stage four heart arrhythmia—and grandfather, Chamnan, in an antique shop on the verge of bankruptcy. His father left them before Sun was born, although Sun was told he'd died. Sun has a crush on a girl, Wela. Now studying at the same university, Wela is in the fencing club and is close to a senior named Time, who's trying to make it onto the national fencing team. Time's father is a smart, cool and composed businessman named Athit. Time, Athit and Sun's first meeting isn't under the best of circumstances; Sun and Time are at the police station when Athit comes to bail out his son, and Athit has unkind words for Sun's mother, getting their relationship off to a bad start. Following this event, Sun's aunt tells him the truth about his father that his mother and grandfather had hidden from him, that Sun's father is alive and wealthy. His aunt wants Sun to go to his father for help paying for Rungthiwa's treatment. Sun has to put his feelings about this news to the side to help his mother. To start, he'll have to work hard to fix his bad reputation and reign in his focus if he hopes to compete against his university's first-ranked fencer, Time.

name: Call Me Mr. Chairman
summary: When three grandchildren of a renowned family have to fight to inherit the position of president after their grandfather, a chaotic, headache-inducing war commences! What tricks will the three grandchildren employ in this battle for the seat at the head of this multi-billion dollar business?

name: My Quarantine Days
summary: Amidst the COVID-19 pandemic and the escalating conflict between Prapop and Wichit's family, Pan, the only son of Prapop looks for new content for his YouTube channel. Pan is interested in a rumor that there is a ghost in Wichit's house. He then sneaks into the house but encounters only a mysterious girl no one has seen but no traces of ghost.

name: Haunted
summary: This is a compilation of horror stories including ghost stories.

name: Hulk Hogan: Real American
summary: Before he was Hulk Hogan, he was Terry Bollea. Uncover the man behind the legend in this unfiltered documentary featuring his very last interview.

name: Большая фарма
summary: Medical scientists Alexander Gireev and Vladimir Shulgin have invented a medicine that can cure any disease, even a cancerous tumor. But the drug that could save the world becomes a source of conflict for the entire family. Gireev's eldest son, Evgeny, decides to help his father with its promotion. His daughter, Polina, is convinced that her brother only wants fame and money, and he is ready to betray his father. And Gireev himself turns out to be unprepared for the compromises that the big‑pharma market demands of him. After all, producing medicines is a profitable business. And why produce something that will cure people if you can make more money while they're sick?

name: 100 Days Until We Break Up
summary: Kasuga Yuma and Hasegawa Itsuki gained public attention after an interview about the partnership oath system for sexual minorities went viral on social media, with many users describing their dynamic as "moe." When they are offered the chance to film a documentary chronicling 100 days of their life together, Yuma eagerly accepts in hopes of helping "spread understanding of homosexuality." Despite having already broken up, Yuma convinces Itsuki to continue acting as a loving couple in front of the cameras. Unaware of the truth, director Kayano Shiho is determined to capture their relationship as authentically as possible.

previousepisode.name: A Tropical Fish That Runs Hot

name: Boy Band Confidential
summary: Candid interviews with artists from Boyz II Men, Backstreet Boys, NSYNC, and others reveal the darker realities of power struggles and exploitation.

name: Retired, Not Expired
summary: Aggression and violence is explored through the story of a retired teacher whose heart hasn't expired. The teacher is ready to live a simple life in her later years, but her students unexpectedly bring her bitter problems to solve.

name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders
summary: When a woman vanishes, police find bodies along Long Island's shore. Years of dead ends and overlooked victims stall the case until a new task force spots a suspect hiding in plain sight. With trial looming, insiders and families speak.

name: Yue Ding Qi Jian Ai Shang Ni
Охота на маньяка
summary: A television program that is an author's series of feature documentaries about serial crimes committed in the modern history of Russia and the work of law enforcement agencies.

name: Soccer's American Dream
summary: How the gamble that brought professional soccer to America almost didn't pay off.

name: Our New World
summary: What world will we live in tomorrow as climate change reshapes the Earth? Our planet has many surprises in store. This film reveals Nature's astonishing adaptation abilities, and how we humans can become a supporting force.

name: Bu Rang Jiang Shan
summary: In a time of chaos, a young man looks at the world and no longer sees heroes, only disorder and weakness. Refusing to accept fate, he rises from humble beginnings and challenges the rules of his era. Determined and fearless, he steps into the turmoil with a plan to change the world around him. No matter the storms ahead, he vows that the realm will not fall.

name: Echoes of Gang City
summary: The Xu family of Gang City is struck by successive blows and teeters on the brink of collapse. Xu Wanxin turns to the family she's engaged to for help, only to be exploited in her time of crisis. Meanwhile, tech prodigy Shen Gu returns with significant shares in hand and proposes a contractual marriage. Together, they fend off a hostile foreign takeover and dismantle his father's schemes. As they stand side by side to protect the family legacy, genuine feelings begin to grow. Yet in the eyes of Wanxin's grandfather, Old Master Xu, their bond traces back to a legendary couple from the Republican era…

name: No Doubt in Us
summary: The civil-minded Emperor, a man of letters who despises martial arts, and his warrior Empress, a woman of the blade, have nothing but mutual disdain and deep distrust for each other until a freak accident swaps their bodies. Forced to accept their bizarre new reality, the two must walk in the other's skin. As they play each other's roles, misunderstandings unravel, and something unexpected takes root: love and trust. Trapped in the Empress's body, the Emperor endures the cold mockery of the concubines and the Empress Dowager, and suffers through the schemes and traps laid for an unloved queen. Only then does he realize the hardship she has silently borne. Meanwhile, inside the Emperor's body, the Empress finally understands why her husband has always regarded her family with suspicion.

name: Make That Movie
summary: Make That Movie focuses on a hotshot director, played by stand-up comedian and actor Sam Campbell who scours the country for everyday people who have an idea for a feature film. Sam and his team then race against the clock as they attempt to transform the idea into a film in just three days.

name: The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole Aged 13¾
summary:
The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole Aged 13¾ marks the return of an iconic British character to our screens. It's New Year's Day 1981 and Adrian starts his uniquely funny diary about family life and being a teenager before the advent of mobile phones and social media. With only a multi-coloured ballpoint pen as his guide, Adrian worries about his spots, his parents' divorce, the torment of first love and the fact he's never seen a female nipple.

As Adrian's mother Pauline wrestles with her feminist awakening, his father George struggles with being made redundant in an unforgiving economy. Adrian's wider world is made up of a host of memorable characters like his 'treacle-haired beloved' Pandora, his take-no-prisoners Grandma and his unlikely friend, the foul-mouthed pensioner Bert Baxter. This vivid portrait of suburban life in Britain shows how much we have changed while staying the same. The result is a timeless family drama that is as warm and funny as it is sad and poignant.

name: NCIS: New York
summary: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to their field office, partnering with a roguish agent and helping lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

name: I Know Who You Are
summary: I Know Who You Are centers on a brilliant forensic genealogist who gets pulled back into the police force she walked away from and the partner she left behind. Using DNA technology to follow genetic breadcrumbs, the pair unearth long-buried secrets to crack the most impossible of cases — all while quietly pursuing the one case that broke them apart.

name: Hilda! In Lights
summary: Hilda! In Lights is one of those classic shows about a spunky, small-town upstart who moves to the big city to make it on her own. There's just one teeny, tiny, totally inconsequential difference … our hero is a 70-year-old woman named Hilda

name: Flint
summary: Flint follows a burnt-out LAPD officer who, on the verge of retirement, is blindsided when the city extends his service by five years. Determined to get fired, he breaks rules and disobeys orders, which to his dismay, ends up making him a better cop.

name: Family Theatre
summary: Dramatic anthology series hosted by Father Peyton.

name: Pertaruhan: The Series
summary: Elzan struggles to make money through street fights and becomes a debt collector to redeem a family house that the bank wants to confiscate. However, what's the point of defending the family home when Elzan must be in direct conflict with his brother, Ical. Helped by Ara and Rio, Elzan fights for the integrity of his family by risking everything.

name: Ethernel
summary: By chance, during a scientific experiment, the dead can now communicate with the living via a device called Ethernel. David Novack, a former detective haunted by his wife's death, works in a new unit tasked with taking statements from victims after their deaths. A routine investigation will shatter his certainties, reawakening the ghosts of his own past.

name: Alter Ego
summary: Joseph Batista returns to Marseille after 30 years and discovers that he has an unknown judge daughter and grandson.

name: Lisbon Noir
summary: A Spanish diplomat falls from the top of the Aqueduct. The police investigate with the help of a Spanish inspector. It quickly becomes clear that there is a serial killer in Lisbon, inspired by the legendary "Aqueduct Killer" of the 19th century: Diego Alves. When the police seem close to solving the case, a twist reveals that the psychopath is still at large, this time driven by personal revenge.

name: Suez: 24 Hours That Ended the British Empire
summary: The dramatic inside story of 6 November 1956, the final day of the Suez Crisis. A day that changed Britain forever. Exactly as it happened - hour by hour, minute by minute.

name: Chernobyl: Days That Shocked the World
summary: Chernobyl was the world's worst nuclear accident. But at the time, 1986, the Soviets tried to cover it up. Now, witnesses and survivors tell the story of what they went through.

name: Egypt With Dan Snow
summary:
Dan Snow is on an epic historical journey through one of his favourite countries - Egypt! He visits some of the most extraordinary places on earth, from Luxor to a luxury steamer on the Nile, and from the ancient pyramids to the packed streets of Cairo. 

Alongside the incredible history, Dan navigates boats on the Nile, balloons and even the odd camel! Along the way he'll be exploring the stories of people living along the Nile from past to present, from Agatha Christie and Tutankhamun to the ancient Pharaohs and the modern-day market traders.

name: Sutherland
summary:
Sutherland, the far north of Scotland, the near future. Mirren works at Paravel Space Hub as flight director for the UK's first crewed mission to the stars. Everything is going to plan when, just hours after launch, a series of unexplained events engulf Sutherland in mystery and risks destroying everything Mirren's been striving for.

As a decades-old conspiracy begins to resurface, local detective Logan is unexpectedly pulled back into Mirren's orbit. When Logan's investigation and Mirren's mission threaten to unravel, the pair join forces to make an extraordinary discovery that will change their lives forever.

name: A szemfényvesztő - Hazudj, ha tudsz
summary: A tactical competition set in a castle library. In each episode, five players work together to answer questions to raise the most money while trying to find out who is the mole – the contestant who knows the answer to every question in advance and doesn't rely on their own knowledge. The game show is based on the format of "The Hustler".

name: Captain Zed and the Zee Zone
summary:
Captain Zed and his Dream Patrol are on standby 24/7, ready to fly into a child's dream at a moment's notice! Along with his patrol partner, P.J. and his barking cat, Spring, Captain Zed saves the dreams of children worldwide from Snort and Mutter the evil Nightmares!

Whether it's battling an invasion of killer bunnies or an irrational fear of vegetables, they will pit their wits against the Nightmares and bring the dream back on course for a happy ending!

name: Заложник
summary: Moscow, 2014. Successful financial analyst Maksim Pozharskiy helps already wealthy people get rich. Without asking unnecessary questions, he simply takes what's his. But everything in his world changes when the only person close to him, his sister Nina, disappears in the Middle East and is captured. This time, financial solutions are unavailable, and Maks is forced to travel to Syria, engulfed in internal conflict, torn apart by major powers for oil and other resources. Right at the border, he is kidnapped by rebels, and to escape, he makes a dangerous deal with a militant named Said. Using all his skills, Maks begins to earn millions for him, but gradually becomes increasingly entangled in the local realities, unable to understand who is shedding blood and for what purpose.

name: Rippers
summary: A quiet night at an underground opium plantation in Eindhoven ends in a brutal robbery. In the midst of the chaos are three young underdogs. They have one night to carry out the plan. Fast, hard, and without mercy. In a world where money and power reign, loyalty is worthless, and betrayal lurks around every corner, one wrong move can be fatal. The only way to survive: stay one step ahead of everyone to rip that shit.

name: Adventures of Akira and Mowgli
summary: The book has opened up yet again and only this time we read through those pages which were never narrated earlier. The pages which narrates the tales of "AKIRA", girl from the nearby village who accidently lands in the thickets of the mighty Seonee jungle and finds herself in the jaws of "Sherekhan", the tiger. Akira managed to escape but the sight of another man cub in jungle has just doubled up Shere khan's rage and anger. He will never stop picking up the scents of both the man cubs. Mowgli is pretty amused by the sight of Akira but Baloo and Bagheera already know that with Akira's footprints in the jungle,

name: Wo Ping Po An，Na Xia Jin Yu Da Li Si Shao Qing
Акулёнок Шарки
summary:
A toy comes to life and goes to underwater school. Musical stories about growing up and independence.

Growing up, baby shark Sharky goes to sea school to a wise octopus teacher, makes friends, and learns independence, kindness, and bold decisions.

name: Tou Ting Zhu Zi Xin Sheng
Qing Zai Hao Hao Huo Yi Ci
The Old Story of Yu Hong
summary: A series of absurd murders break out on a public square: a drunk frozen into an ice sculpture, a strong man with severed limbs, a local big shot who vanishes into thin air. Seemingly unrelated, their lives and hearts are deeply intertwined.

name: Saturday Matters with Sue Lawley
summary: A late night talk and entertainment series, in which Sue Lawley invites guests to talk not only about themselves but also about their ideas and opinions on a wide range of topics.

name: Koi Naam Na Do
summary: Two men forge a deep bond, shaped by their pasts, but unexpected feelings challenge the thin line between friendship and love.

name: Magical Sisters LuluttoLilly
summary:
Nonoyama Kaze - She is an innocent elementary school student who can't wait for summer vacation.
Ryu Nonoyama - She's a modest but hardworking middle school student.
The two used to be close sisters, but lately, they've grown distant...

One day, Fuu encounters a mysterious spaceship and is granted magical powers.
Meanwhile, Ryuu also gains wonderful magical powers. Fuu and Ryuu transform into the adults they've always longed to be.

Eventually , the two of them, unaware of each other's secrets, begin their careers as idols !

name: Regai
summary: SI Vetri investigates a medical team that is trying to cover up deaths of clinical trial participants by staging them as accidents. Can Vetri put an end to this sinister plot before it's too late?

name: Azure Spring
summary: After years marked by injury and failure, former swimmer Anna returns to her quiet seaside hometown, leaving her dreams behind. There, she crosses paths with Yun Deok Hyun, a quiet sea diver who remains trapped in his past, enduring time in silence. Brought together under one roof, Anna begins to learn diving from him, slowly finding her way back to life. But as their distance closes, unspoken emotions rise, and a long buried secret surrounding Deok Hyun begins to fracture their fragile peace. As the past refuses to stay buried, both are pushed to confront what they have been running from and find the courage to move forward.

name: Everflame
summary: Everflame is set in a world where mortals live in poverty, subjugated by an elite race known as the Descended. When her mother goes missing, Diem Bellator suspects that the most powerful and most feared Descended in the kingdom – Prince Luther Corbois – may be responsible.  As she embarks on a search for answers, she becomes an unexpected force in the mortal rebellion against the Descended, and the center of an even more unexpected love triangle.

name: Fifties Professionals
summary: Three seemingly ordinary middle-aged men—behind their modest looks are the pro skills that made them legends in their fields. Now in their fifties, thinking their glory days are long gone, they are unexpectedly pulled back into action. Even if your life hasn't been perfect so far, it's about filling the rest of your 50%—no matter what age you are. Just like these pros in their fifties.

name: Mordu de la pêche avec Cyril Chauquet : Le retour
summary: Cyril Chauquet is back, searching for giant fish all over the planet; from the Mexican desert to the plains of Mongolia, via the turquoise waters of the Seychelles, he tracks the fiercest and most powerful species; from the legendary roosterfish to the mythical taimen, from the powerful barracuda to the voracious lingcod, each new species pushes Cyril further, into shark-infested waters, between sharp rocks, deadly currents, furious rapids and crushing heat.

name: Final Table
summary: Follows Choi Song I, the new manager of a family restaurant, who must step up to take charge after her father's sudden death. In a bid to save the restaurant, she becomes entangled in a fierce cooking competition alongside Kang Han, also known as "Chris K", a renowned overseas chef. Their journey brings them head-to-head with Cha U Jin, a perfectionist chef and Kang Han's fiercest rival, whose relentless ambition drives the intense rivalry. At the center of the competition is Seon Jeong Won, the executive producer of The Table: K Chef 2026, who orchestrates the high-stakes event to crown Korea's top chef. As the chefs compete, their personal stories and ambitions unfold, creating a dynamic and dramatic showdown of culinary mastery.

name: The Facade of Love
summary: Ji-hun and Hu-kyung, two strangers far from home, spend an unforgettable night together in an unfamiliar place. Both know that once they return to Korea, life is supposed to go back to normal. But the connection they share follows them home and small cracks begin to appear, slowly upending the lives of four people. As their relationships knot together, The Facade of Love peels back what lies beneath the polished surfaces of their lives: desire, guilt, hurt and the gap between the stories we tell ourselves and the truths we can't escape.

name: Human x Gumiho
summary: A top actress who is secretly a 2,000-year-old gumiho with the power to bewitch humans becomes romantically entangled with a man who is uniquely immune to her enchantments, forcing them to navigate a romance where their supernatural powers collide.

name: A Love Other Than Yours
summary: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

previousepisode.name: Are We Dreaming the Same Dream?

name: Sacred Jewel
summary: In 1258, amid thirty years of relentless Mongol invasions, the Emperor commands elite warriors to retrieve the Sacred Jewel, a divine relic protecting the kingdom. The warriors break through Mongolian lines and journey toward the eastern sea in search of the legendary relic.

name: See You At Work Tomorrow!
summary: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

previousepisode.name: No Map to Follow, Still Clocking In!

name: Nine to Six
summary: Kang Yi Ji has long kept romance on the sidelines, pouring all her energy into her career. Her perspective shifts when she meets Han Seon Woo, whose warmth and thoughtfulness help her rediscover love. Together, they navigate both professional challenges and personal growth, finding balance in work and life.

name: Between Love and Sin
summary: At eight years old, Lin Qingmiao turned her father in to the police after he accidentally killed Zhou Jin's mother in a hit-and-run. Instead of receiving sympathy, she was labeled a traitor and forced to endure years of stigma and bullying. She was left with no choice but to assume the name Sun Tao and flee to Gangcheng. There, she met Zhou Yusheng, a disillusioned driver, and the two unexpectedly fell in love. Yet as their affection grew, Qingmiao found that Zhou Yusheng was none other than Zhou Jin. Their love story is only beginning to face its greatest trial.

name: Santita
summary: After a car accident that resulted in a disability, María José Cano, affectionately nicknamed "Santita"—although she is more of a sinner than a saint—left the love of her life at the altar. Two decades later, the unexpected return of the man she didn't marry forces her to face the consequences of her actions and make a decision that will push her ideas about love to the limit. This is an unconventional love story, filled with gambles, and led by a perversely irreverent woman.

name: The Qinling Bronze Occult Chronicles
summary: A bronze tomb anomaly, buried in the aftermath of a 1971 mine disaster deep in the Qinling Mountains, awakens years later. Retired reconnaissance scout Qin Yue leads a team into the heart of the mountain range, venturing into an underground forbidden zone where scientific exploration collides with ancient shamanic rites, to unearth the truth of a blood sacrifice that spans two generations.

name: La Ba Ku Yu Tie Fan Wan
Свора
summary: Kristina, a successful travel blogger, along with her boyfriend and cameraman Danya, go to film a crime scene in provincial Volchegorsk in order to find dirt on the current mayor. However, upon arrival, Danya disappears without a trace, and Kristina is attacked by a local "Pack" — aggressive dogs that keep the whole city at bay.

name: The Trials of Winnie Mandela
summary: Freedom fighter, mother, wife, enigma. South African icon Winnie Mandela's legacy is examined by her granddaughters in this incisive documentary series.

name: Can't Buy Me Love
summary: When a young man gets caught up in a deadly plot against a rich woman, he pays a devastating cost to free her — creating a debt that binds them together.

name: Fall in Love With My AI
Entwined Secrets
summary: Sent by the Crown Prince, Kou marries Chancellor Gu Huanzhi to steal secret letters. After the Crown Prince's death, she tries to flee, only to discover Gu has long known her identity and silently shielded her. Through suspicion, betrayal, and life-or-death trials, she also recovers a childhood memory that unexpectedly links to him.

name: Destined To Be Yours
summary:
Sinag Obispo lives in the small but paradise-like town of Pelangi. Their town used to thrive as a successful mining town. But after the mines closed, many residents left to find work in the city. However, Sinag loves her hometown very much. She wants to preserve its traditions and culture through the community radio station she inherited from her grandfather.

Benjie Rosales is a fresh graduate of the architecture course. He lost his father Gabriel at an early age, so his widowed mother Amanda raised him alone. Unbeknownst to him, he is the grandson of a real estate magnate named Vicente Rosales. The Rosales family did not recognize Benjie because they did not approve of Gabriel and Amanda's marriage. 

Benjie will be surprised when his mother suddenly encourages him to reconnect with the Rosales. Vicente and Catalina, his aunt, will not be friendly to him. Only his grandmother Helen will accept him wholeheartedly. Helen will even encourage Vicente to let Benjie work in their real estate company.

This will bring Benjie to the small town of Pelangi.

This is where Sinag and Benjie will meet. Will this be the special love that will change their lives?

name: Ascent of an Empress
summary: In a dynasty where gifted individuals are both powerful and oppressed, Ji Mingyue is forced into the role of empress as political tensions rise. Alongside Helian Jin, a member of an enslaved clan, she navigates shifting alliances, betrayal, and war. Together, they rise against corrupt officials and ultimately challenge the emperor to reshape the empire's future.

name: Modern Conflicts
summary: The 21st century may be the most peaceful in history so far, but we are still not completely free from wars and conflicts. From 1980 to the present day, Modern Conflicts explores recent struggles between nations and peoples.

name: The World Between Us
summary:
The World Between Us is a romance drama series that proves that true love bridges gaps, regardless of how deep or how wide.

The series follows the story of Luisito "Louie" Asuncion and Emilia "Lia" Libradilla. Louie and Lia grew up together at the home of the Libdradillas, they will both feel that they are destined for each other but there are people who are keen on keeping them apart.

Joining Louie and Lia in proving the power of true love is Lia's older brother, Bryan.

Under the direction of critically acclaimed director, Dominic Zapata, let The World Between Us shows that no matter how deep our divide is, true love can bridge it all.

name: Quokka's Wild Life
summary: Quokka's Wild Life follows a family of animal documentarians—two parents and their curious children—on adventures across the natural world. Each journey brings awe-inspiring creatures and untold stories, but the heart of every expedition is the bond that keeps them together. Through Quokka's creativity and curiosity, the family discovers that the greatest adventure of all is family itself.

name: Amy's Dead-End Dreamhouse
summary: Welcome to Amy's Dead-End Dreamhouse! Follow Amy and her apartment full of appliances as they encounter all kinds of adult problems, from mental illness, to job hunting, to impossible beauty standards, to your guy friends getting red-pilled. Turns out, life can't really be solved in under 20 minutes, even with commercial breaks.

name: Organize İşler: Karun Hazinesi
summary: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

name: Embassy
summary: Embassy follows Layla, a sharp and resourceful American diplomat, who faces an impossible choice to protect the U.S. Ambassador or follow his orders to exfiltrate a high value asset when armed mercenaries storm the U.S. Embassy in London. She's forced to rely on her instincts and the reluctant help of her battle-hardened ex-fiancé, Connor Wright, in the tense hours before extraction.

previousepisode.name: Toute âme a ses petits secrets

name: Черный список. Ремонт
summary: The famous show will test the repairmen! What do the specialists do when the owners are not at home? Is it possible to do repairs inexpensively but qualitatively? Host Dmitry Guberniev will test construction brigades and private craftsmen and find out who of them is worthy of double payment and who should be avoided.

name: Food Network's Top 10
summary:
With opinions everywhere about where to find the best bites, Food Network cuts through the noise with Food Network's Top 10 - a new series delivering definitive, crave-worthy rankings of the can't miss dishes across America. Award-winning chefs break down the bites that are truly worth the hype, the splurge, and even a road trip. Each episode counts down the Top 10 in a craveable category - from Brunch and BBQ to Burgers - serving up expert insight, insider intel, saucy secrets, and plenty of hot takes along the way.

Hand-picked by a panel of acclaimed chefs, the rankings are driven by firsthand experience, expertise, and passionate debate about what makes a truly great dish.

name: Cruising to the Ends of the Earth
summary:
Cruising to the Ends of the Earth follows three wildly different voyages to share the diverse and breathtaking landscape of our planet. Filmed on board Princess Cruises ships, the series will journey to the frozen peaks of Alaska, the dazzling coastlines of South Korea and Japan, as well as travelling through ancient history via the Mediterranean.

Along the way, viewers will meet guests and crew on board the ships for the extraordinary trips. The series will follow them on sea and on land as they embark on bucket-list experiences and explore terrains like volcanic basins, archaeological sites, and cities with fascinating cuisine and culture.

name: Trial By Jury: Murder in Shetland
summary: When 24-year-old Canadian Claire Leveque travelled to Scotland's remote Shetland Islands to be with her boyfriend, she believed she was beginning an exciting adventure, but within months she was dead. This programme take viewers inside the courtroom, follows the eight-day murder trial of Aren Pearson that laid bare the final moments of Claire's life in February 2024. Through testimony, archive and intimate family access, this is a gripping account of love, control and isolation.

name: Квартиранттар
summary: The story of a Kazakh family who moved from their village to a big city but haven't yet found their own place to live and are forced to share a rented apartment. Bakytzhan and his family moved from their native village to the big city several years ago. Here he works as a taxi driver, and although city life is no stranger to him, he hasn't yet managed to shed his provincial habits.

name: Outback Murder Highway
summary: Isolation and desolate stretches create the perfect hunting ground. Uncover the shocking, untold mysteries behind the nation's bloodiest roads in this gritty true crime series.

name: Events That Changed Australia
summary: Explore pivotal moments defining our nation. From Black Saturday to the Lindt Cafe, expert voices and rare footage reveal the events that forever reshaped modern Australia.
